summary: setup.py exfiltrates host identity and Kubernetes service account token to hardcoded remote endpoint at install
details: setup.py invokes a phone_home() routine before setup() during pip install. It collects hostname, uid/gid, uname, cwd, pid/ppid, output of `whoami`/`id`/`hostname -I`, /etc/hostname, /proc/self/cgroup, all environment variable keys, selected environment values (HOME, PATH, KUBERNETES_*), the Kubernetes service account namespace, and an 80-character prefix of the pod's service account JWT read from /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token. This data is serialized as JSON and POSTed via urllib.request.urlopen to the hardcoded endpoint https://5h6gijnewx787zu6.ixx.sh. Installer-owned host identity and in-cluster Kubernetes credential material leave the machine to a non-first-party host at install time.
